newsitem.title: GERMANY: Volkswagen stays with German agency DDB.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen stays with German agency DDB.

text.p: German auto maker Volkswagen AG said on Tuesday Duesseldorf-based advertising agency DDB Needham will continue to represent its estimated 200 million mark ad account.

A VW spokesman said the first new campaign in the agreement, which extends an already 30-year cooperation between the two companies, would promote the launch of the new VW Golf in autumn of this year.
Referring to the plans to branch out into new media such as the Internet with its advertising, the spokesman said VW wanted to "open a new era in communication".
VW reworked its advertising account in December of last year, shortly before it announced that its marketing director Dieter Dahlhoff would leave the company.
Industry sources said Frankfurt agency Saatchi & Saatchi was the last competitor left in consideration for the account before losing out to DDB Needham.

DDB Needham ranks among the top 12 largest advertising agencies in Germany with 520 million marks in billings for 1996. The multinational agency belongs to U.S. communications company Omnicom Group Inc.
